name: guru-maker
description: Five skills to remember decisions, re-test assumptions, and grow project-owned investment knowledge.

interface.shortDescription: Five skills for investment memory and decisions
interface.longDescription: Research, remember, decide, train, and share while re-testing prior assumptions.
defaultPrompt: Use $guru-research to investigate this investment question with current evidence and project memory.
Use $guru-decision to synthesize this point-in-time judgment and its evidence.
Use $guru-memory to inspect or explicitly change Guru Mode.
Use $guru-train to turn this reviewed postmortem into a reusable lesson.
